svg.text: WLD 205 DAY 3 — INSTRUCTOR KEY / PRINT-TO-PART GUIDE
Blueprint Recovery I: Lines, Views, Dimensions + Notes
0–8 MIN — LINE-FUNCTION RETRIEVAL / Q1–5
Object/visible = visible edges/features.
Hidden = edges/features not visible in the current view.
Centerline = center/axis/symmetry.
Dimension line = numerical size/location information.
Extension line = extends from feature to dimension line.
Correct the line function, not just the vocabulary word.
8–18 MIN — TRAINING PLATE A PHYSICAL MODEL
Hold the plate/model in front-view orientation. Ask where an edge, hole, and notch appear on the print.
Rotate 90°. Ask what happened to the hole and why hidden lines are needed.
Measure/verify: 6 in length, 4 in height, hole center 2 in from left and bottom.
Key statement: print = required part; measuring tool = actual part.
Whiteboard: PRINT → PART / READ → FIND → MEASURE → VERIFY.
18–38 MIN — BRIDGE PRINT A / FRAME-A / Q6–11
Q6 width = 12.000 in.
Q7 height = 8.000 in.
Q8 bottom to middle horizontal = 4.000 in.
Q9 units controlled by GENERAL NOTE: ALL DIMENSIONS IN INCHES.
Q10 material = 1 × 1 square tube.
Q11 missing welding parameters = approved WPS/SWPS.
Reading order: TITLE / VIEW → NOTES → DIMENSIONS → SYMBOLS → QUESTIONS.
38–52 MIN — BLUEPRINT MATH / Q12
Outer frame stock before allowance/kerf: 2 × 12 + 2 × 8 = 40 in.
Require units and the source dimension used. Keep allowance/kerf separate from this theoretical total.
Do not invent cut allowance or procedure values that are not in the controlling source.
52–60 MIN — BLUEPRINT EXIT / Q13–15
Q13: use drawing note/title-block conventions for units. Q14: dimension lines do not provide welding parameters.
Q15: stop and resolve conflicting source information before acting.
Remediate only the failed domain: Line Functions | Print Locate/Notes | Dimension Math | Source Control.
